address: 2 rue de la Cerdagne, Saleilles, 66280, France
bio: Do not be misled by the colonial feel of this large building, you can trust the experienced chef to surprise your taste buds. With a single set menu that changes weekly, he cooks up modern and creative dishes that reflect the seasons: croustillant with parmesan, marinated chanterelles and a sweet garlic cream; turbot fillet tempura, coconut, lemongrass and a ginger emulsion....
